svg.text: AI agents doing the data work. So AI agents can do the business work.
We apply the same AI agent technology to data engineering that you'll use to run your business — building the foundation first.
AI can be applied to any domain. Data Workbench applies it to the domain of data engineering — building the foundation AI needs to work.
WITHOUT DATA WORKBENCH — manual, fragmented, ungoverned
WITH DATA WORKBENCH AGENT SKILLS — AI doing the data engineering work
WHAT BECOMES POSSIBLE — enterprise AI with certified data products to reason over
AI builds the foundation. The foundation enables AI.
The same agent technology that will run your business — applied today to build the data it depends on.
